policies.bribe: Native attributed two-minion generation for the caster then opponent, followed by one native own-board transform batch with printed Cost+1 and no retained original cost. Complete pool queries, captured physical minions, ordinary transformations and current capacity are reused. Caster/opponent order and transform acceptance remain M6.
policies.rafaams: Exactly eleven fixed-source3928 identities, including Baaaafam, form the finite named family. The full parent and Giant price gap remain unsupported; no Fabled or deck-size declaration is registered. Eight complete companion bodies plus their real Sheep are independent reachable content. No class or name-substring substitute.
policies.draw: Tiny and Explorer use the exact finite named family complement over the final immutable registry, evaluated at each actual body. Every physical deck entity already requires a complete executable definition; no family member is excluded by implementation status. Tiny uses native physical DrawMatching with explicit skip; Explorer uses native sampled own-deck take without fabricated draw. Native physical entity weighting, distinct offers and take-vs-draw remain M6. The positive DrawMatching card_ids codec requires all referenced definitions and is therefore not used while parent/Giant remain unsupported.
policies.stats: Green captures other friendly hand and active board Rafaams once, then native guarded stored/board buffs. Archmage captures all current active non-Rafaam minions on both boards before ordinary transformations; original reentry cannot adopt delayed work. Family-current-face and transformation windows remain M6.
policies.rewards: Warchief performs5 Armor then checks the actual hand after first Armor reactions for another5. Mindflayer uses an original current-copy request only while holding another Rafaam, no Battlecry on copy. Calamitous uses one MINION_ABILITY DamageBatch. Murloc installs a native one-use next-price modifier with all eleven exact card_ids, lifetime and payment unchanged.
policies.unsupported_multiverse: TIME_014 complete original raw and both strict faces retained as evidence only. Native first attempt and keep succeeded, but real Rewind retry after actual Overload3 fails the existing overload-history committed-increment boundary. Entire card and its budget composition are excluded from final registration; original frozen-01 and complete failed special-01 retained for main review.

named_dependency_links.basis: Full printed Archmage 1/1 Sheep; unique full1/1 Sheep face in the same exact primary parent bundle. Both full primary Sheep faces and raw3928 identity retained. The API does not declare a direct Archmage child edge.
